The '''Meccha Wingrider Garrison''' was a location near [[Meccha]], formerly inhabited by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatas]] then by a garrison of [[Wingriders]], the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] of the [[Drall/Legends|Dralls]].
